subject.title: docs: add direct Kubernetes manifest apply path

question: Should OpenClaw officially support a generated single-file Kubernetes manifest applied from the raw GitHub `main` URL, or should this work be narrowed to neutral Helm/Kustomize wording only?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and proven, but it creates a new official install/support surface with upgrade and versioning implications that automation cannot accept on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this PR now; a maintainer can reopen or request a fresh PR if OpenClaw wants to own the direct raw-GitHub manifest path.

options.title: Sponsor direct manifest support
options.body: Accept the support direction, require the branch to be rebased, and decide whether the docs should use `main`, a release tag, or another versioned URL.

options.title: Narrow to wording-only docs
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that removes the negative Helm framing while leaving the official install workflow on the existing deploy script and manifest directory.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR now; a maintainer can reopen or request a fresh PR if OpenClaw wants to own the direct raw-GitHub manifest path.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Kubernetes install guide and manifest baseline that this PR extends.
